decisions.reason: It is close to the established cheese range, appears to have survived the initial trial period, and in a growing organic dairy market its likely low carrying cost makes keeping this option more attractive than dropping it.

As a spiced variant it is somewhat more niche and therefore more vulnerable to rationalization, but because it builds on existing capabilities and the firm has a narrow portfolio, management would still be inclined to keep it unless clearer signs of weak demand emerge.

This mild soft cheese seems to fit the firm's healthy, enjoyable organic positioning well, and after remaining visible beyond launch its prospects look good enough that the option value of keeping it exceeds the likely cost of continuation.
